business_problem: Groupe BPCE wanted to transform banking operations and customer experience at scale, improving back-office productivity, frontline advisor support, mobile customer interactions, contact center automation, fraud detection, and IT efficiency.
solution_summary: Groupe BPCE built an in-house AI operating layer that spans employee productivity, customer service, fraud detection, and IT support. The deployment is centered on a secure internal AI assistant rolled out to all 100,000 employees, alongside dedicated AI agents for account advisors, a mobile-app AI assistant for customer conversations, an AI voice agent in customer relationship centers, predictive AI for fraud monitoring, and Gen AI tools used in coding and testing. Inputs come from employee prompts, customer chat sessions, inbound calls, and transaction streams; the AI systems then generate responses, automate call handling, or score suspicious activity, with outputs served back to staff, app users, contact-center workflows, and IT teams. The source does not disclose the storage stack, model vendors, or orchestration tooling, but it shows AI embedded in core banking processes with KPI-based tracking across adoption, service volume, fraud coverage, and engineering usage.
